78536.subject: Claude Commerce Agents: Inside Anthropic's Merchant-Side Bet on Agentic Commerce 🤖🛍️
78536.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/claude-commerce-agents

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 400k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
On September 2, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Commerce Agents [ https://substack.com/redirect/f03f2513-0ae6-4fdd-ade8-ba49481653f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], an open blueprint for building AI shopping agents and merchant-operations agents on Claude. The rest of the industry is still fighting over the consumer gateway: Google and Shopify run live agentic checkout in AI Mode and Gemini through the Universal Commerce Protocol [ https://substack.com/redirect/80e56430-eb8b-4af6-ac26-6a05c1715bf5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Microsoft’s Copilot Checkout counts more than 500,000 participating merchants, Perplexity sells in-chat through Instant Buy with PayPal, and Amazon’s Buy for Me completes purchases from inside its app. OpenAI tried the same play and failed. It retired ChatGPT’s in-chat Instant Checkout in March 2026, roughly five months after launch, after flagship partner Walmart found conversion inside the chatbot ran about three times below its own site. ChatGPT now hands shoppers to retailer apps and merchant sites to complete the purchase.
That retreat revealed exactly the world Anthropic built for: shoppers discover in AI but buy on the merchant’s property. Claude Commerce Agents is therefore working agent code that lives inside the merchant’s own website, app, and back office.
The release contains shopping- and merchant-agent implementations, four runnable vertical examples, a safety harness, eval patterns, a Claude Code builder plugin, and deployment paths across the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Cloud Vertex AI. It is not a consumer shopping destination, a commerce protocol, or a payment processor: nothing in the reference implementation places an order or charges a card. The narrow scope is the whole strategy. Anthropic wants Claude to be the intelligence and runtime inside merchants’ experiences while catalogs, checkout, payment, fulfillment, customer ownership, and regulatory responsibility stay with merchants and their infrastructure providers.
The launch matters for five key reasons:
It moves Anthropic from model vendor toward application architecture owner. The blueprint prescribes how a commerce agent should be built, rather than only which model it should call, and it runs the same code across Anthropic’s API and all three major clouds.
It is a merchant-control counter-position to AI shopping gateways. While rivals intermediate the merchant, Anthropic starts with an agent embedded in the merchant’s own property and an agent used by the merchant’s staff. Payments remain the merchant’s choice, and checko

----------

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** OpenAI just released GPT-6 Astra and its president says we're in the AGI era now. The same morning, Bernie Sanders announced a bill that would put people in prison for building it, Google made your weather app 5x sharper and ChatGPT, Claude and Grok all went down at once.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **OpenAI:** What can Astra do on your computer that Sol couldn't?

* **Bernie:** Who goes to prison under his new bill?

* **Google:** Why is your weather app suddenly right?

* **Outage:** What took ChatGPT, Claude and Grok down at the same time?


----------







----------
## OpenAI drops ChatGPT Astra

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/46cb6741-aadc-4208-8f0e-5b3dfa862740/111.png?t=1788484593)
Caption: 

OpenAI just released [GPT-6 Astra](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/). Greg Brockman ended the press briefing with "Welcome to the AGI era."

* Rolling out to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise over the coming days, inside your current plan limits.

* 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3 using OpenAI's own harness, 62.7% on ARC Prize's standard test, Sol had 7.8%.

* 100% on ExploitBench, the hacking test, and 95.9% on CAD design against Fable 5.1's 84.3%.

* API price is $10 and $50 per million tokens, same as Fable 5.1 and 2.5x Sol.

The big feature is computer use. Brockman says it zips through spreadsheets, fills forms and navigates websites at superhuman speed. OpenAI showed it laying out a circuit board and says it can draft your tax return from a W-2.

It's the first OpenAI model rated Critical for hacking, so the version you get refuses advanced cyber work. OpenAI also admitted it's harder to monitor than Sol and will hold off scaling until it can watch these models properly.

Is it AGI? Brockman says it's not unreasonable to feel that way. I'll answer when it shows up in my ChatGPT.


----------







----------
## The AI that learns one person

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/82fd77ad-7c00-4bee-95e5-b78c3f7e6edb/08_stevenouri-x_1200x630.png?t=1788484807)
Follow image link: (https://utm.genai.works/r/mfysrj9)
Caption: 

Most AI models are trained on the whole internet. [Uare.ai](https://Uare.ai) is trained on you. Every person on the platform creates a model built on their own voice, work, and thinking. You own the model, and it learns from you and no one else.

Profess
